Package com.cg.training.daoImplementation

Class BookDAOImplementation

java.lang.Object
com.cg.training.daoImplementation.BookDAOImplementation
All Implemented Interfaces:
BookDAO
public class BookDAOImplementation extends Object implements BookDAO
BookDAOImplementation provides an in-memory and file-based implementation of the BookDAO interface. It manages operations such as adding, removing, retrieving, and saving Book records.

Book data is loaded from and saved to a file at resources/books.txt.

    • addBook

      public void addBook(Book book)
      Adds a book to the system. If a book with the same title already exists, its count is incremented instead.
      Specified by:

      Parameters:
      book - the Book object to be added; must not be null

    • removeBook

      public void removeBook(String title)
      Decrements the count of a book by title. If count reaches 0 or less, the book is marked as unavailable.
      Specified by:
      removeBook in interface BookDAO
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the book to remove; must not be null or empty
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the title is null or empty
